What these numbers mean

We measure what actually fills a calendar.

Vanity metrics don't pay the bills. Here's what we track instead — and why it matters for a trades business.

Cost per booked call

Not cost per click. We optimize toward the number that predicts revenue — a confirmed appointment on the calendar.

Show-up rate

A booked call that no-shows is worthless. Our follow-up systems are built to keep appointments on the books.

Ad spend efficiency

Every dollar is tracked back to a lead source, a campaign, and an outcome — so budget moves toward what's working.
